    AI Overview
    The 130th Boston Marathon is scheduled for Monday, April 20, 2026, held annually on Patriots' Day. The race in Hopkinton, Massachusetts, will feature elite fields, with the men's wheelchair division starting at 9:06 a.m. ET. 
    Key Details for 2026: 
    • Date: Monday, April 20, 2026.
    • Location: Hopkinton to Boston, MA.
    • Start Time: The first wave (men's wheelchair) begins at 9:06 a.m. ET, with other divisions following.
    • Coverage:
      Live coverage is generally available on WCVB Channel 5 (local) and ESPN/ESPN2 (national).
       
    The event is the second of seven World Marathon Majors in 2026.
